description:
We have to use Ubuntu package manager apt-get to install MySQL server. Just run

apt-get install mysql-server

If you want to interact with server, obviously we need to install client, just type

apt-get install mysql-client

If you didn't see any error message,Congratulations! you have successfully installed MySQL!

Lets test your IQ with simple question :p Do you know What does the word Ubuntu mean?
name: Mysql Installation

description:
In order to configure MySQL server, we need to start it first with command like

service mysqld start

Now run MySQL Secure Installation binary

mysql_secure_installation

This will prompt you for

Enter current password for root (enter for none):

Just press enter, we don't have any root password. Then it will ask for

Change the root password?

Press Y to set root password.

Press 'Y' to remove anonymous user and test db. like

Remove anonymous users?[Y/n] Y

Finally, If you want, you can also disable remote MySQL root login.

Disallow root login remotely? [Y/n] Y

And reload the tables!
name: Configure MySQL server
Verify the Installation
description:
Great! You have Installed and Configured MySQL Server under Ubuntu. Now Its time to verify the installation.

Do you remember the MySQL root password? okay great!, Now connect to server (mysqld) via client (mysql) with command :

mysql -u root -p
